"""Unit tests for the open decision."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from data.ingest.loader import load_trades

D5_OPEN = "D5 open: whether a zero-size row is kept"
ROW = "2026-09-01T13:30:20Z,AAA,49.74,0,sell\n"


@pytest.mark.xfail(reason=D5_OPEN)
def test_zero_size_row_dropped(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A zero-size row is dropped, once D5 says so."""
    csv_file = tmp_path / "trades.csv"
    csv_file.write_text("ts,symbol,price,size,side\n" + ROW)
    assert load_trades(csv_file) == []
